PlantMate helps neighbours give plants a second home: give away, trade, care and chat about plants nearby.
Sharing plants for free or swapping them is the heart of the app.
Your Garden, watering reminders and the Community help plants thrive.
You can list a plant for sale, but there is no payment, cart or delivery in PlantMate.
Mầm gives basic care guidance. Plant Doctor uses AI to suggest the species and likely problems from a photo; treat it as a helpful hint, not a certain diagnosis.
Photos you add to listings and posts are resized on your phone before they are shared.
Reports are private. Blocking stops new messages between you and that member.
